reviews.author: Nick Dugolas
reviews.text:
Thank you for your review. However, I think it’s important to set the record straight about how our phone conversation actually went.

You called me requesting a quote for modifications to an existing fence. While I was explaining the pricing over the phone and what was involved in completing the work, you rudely interrupted me with, “Oh, that’s too expensive,” before I even had the opportunity to finish speaking.

You’re absolutely entitled to your opinion and to have a budget. However, there’s a respectful way to communicate that something is outside your price range without interrupting someone who is taking the time to explain the costs involved.

You mentioned in your review that you contacted a professional because you didn’t understand the ins and outs of the job. Yet you were quick to judge the price before allowing that professional to finish explaining what the work involved.

Just because a job appears simple to you doesn’t mean there isn’t time, labour, materials, experience and business costs involved.

Could I have responded differently? Absolutely. But I won’t sit back and accept a completely one-sided version of events that makes out you were nothing but polite throughout the conversation.

I find it disappointing that you felt the need to leave a public review questioning my professionalism and ability to run a business simply because you didn’t agree with my pricing.

I’ve worked hard to build DIY Dale Fencing, and I stand behind my workmanship and the prices I charge. I don’t expect to win every job, and I’m certainly not going to be the cheapest contractor just to please everyone.

Professionalism and respect go both ways. Being a customer doesn’t automatically give you the right to speak over someone and then publicly criticise them when you don’t like their response.

I wish you all the best finding a contractor who suits your budget.

DIY Dale Fencing

reviews.text: In Oct 2026 Matt from Sentry fencing did a fantastic job in replacing an old wooden fence with a colourbond fence. The fence looks perfect even though we are on a sloping property. Matt organised the survey and council approval, he even shifted our big shed plus bench for us. Throughout he was very easy and reliable to communicate with. We could not be happier about the excellent job he did with the retaining wall and fence.

reviews.author: dougie johnstone
reviews.text: Our back fence blew down during a recent storm. Matt from Sentry Fencing visited and quoted us a really competitive price within a couple days. The job was carried out around 2 weeks later. Matt did a superb job, fence looks great and he cleared up every bit of old fence and mess that resulted. He worked during an awful day of weather also. Highly recommend these guys.

reviews.author: Danica Spurr
reviews.text: Fast, professional and affordable. Matt fit us in to his schedule when we needed our fence done quickly. He gave us a lot of options to consider and checked in with us on what we wanted. Highly recommend Matt and Sentry Fences to anyone needing a fence installed.

reviews.author: Steve Harris
reviews.text:
Matt from Sentry Fencing replace our 33m boundary fence, and we couldn’t be happier with the result\!

Matt was fantastic to deal with from start to finish and made the whole process really simple and hassle\-free\. The workmanship was excellent, the price was very fair, and everything was completed to a really high standard\.

We absolutely love our new Colourbond fence with retaining plinths — it’s made such a difference to the look of the property\.

Thanks heaps, Matt\! 👍
Would definitely recommend Sentry Fencing and will happily use you again in the future\. 👌

reviews.author: Katie Rebekah
reviews.text:
BLC Fencing were engaged by my property manager, Harcourts, to replace a storm-damaged pool fence at my investment property in August 2023 – and they were a nightmare from start to finish.

They installed a non-compliant fence, which resulted in serious issues with the City of Joondalup. Instead of taking any responsibility, they completely washed their hands of the situation. What should have been a straightforward job turned into a drawn-out, stressful ordeal involving substantial workaround works, additional costs (for both me and Harcourts), and countless hours of follow-up.

It took OVER A FULL YEAR to resolve – by September 2024, I’d lost tenants who were fed up with the unsafe conditions, temporary fences, endless visits from the council and ridiculous delays. The workmanship was poor, they were unreliable, and communication was appalling. To make the fence "compliant", I’ve been left with random pieces of perspex slapped onto the fence and great chunks ripped away from what had previously been a lovely rustic brick BBQ feature – a truly dodgy-looking result for something that cost thousands of dollars. Absolute cowboys.

Less than a year after installation, the gate fixture broke – and again, they ignored all follow-up emails about getting it repaired, leaving me to foot the bill yet again. When we sent them the repair invoice, they instantly replied; "it is a standard maintenance issue and not something that BLC Fencing is obligated to repair under the terms and conditions of a warranty."
Final straw, guys.

As such, this review has been a long time coming. For the record, I have definitely got the right company. BLC Fencing should be ashamed of their conduct.

AVOID, AVOID, AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!

reviews.text: Fantastic service! My asbestos fence fell down in a storm. BLC were quick to come for a quote on a Friday afternoon and super friendly. They got the job done efficiently and safely, with minimal disruption. Fence looks fantastic and they did the whole job, including asbestos removal, in just a few days. Bree and Matt were a pleasure to deal with.

reviews.author: 940314denis
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Hanson Fencing! The pricing was very reasonable and I’m really happy with the final result.

I’m quite a picky customer and had a lot of specific ideas about how I wanted the fence and sliding gate to look. Peter was always responsive, patient and very flexible throughout the whole process. They were happy to work with my ideas and custom-made the fence and gate to achieve the design and look I wanted.

A special shoutout to the Vietnamese installer who speaks Chinese and helped with the electrical wiring and gate motor installation. He was extremely attentive to detail and didn’t just focus on getting the job done, he would actually think about the small details and suggest ways to make the fence and gate look cleaner and better. I really appreciated the extra care he put into the job.

The intercom was also installed very neatly and everything came together nicely.

Really appreciate Peter and the Hanson Fencing team for their patience, flexibility and workmanship. Very happy with the finished product and would definitely recommend them!

reviews.author: AR Merlino
reviews.text:
Highly recommend Valente Fencing. Peter was absolutely amazing they worked unsupervised, cleaned up after himself every day, and his workmanship was outstanding which is very rare to find in trades these days.

What really stood out was that while other trades only wanted to quote for a complete replacement, Peter was happy to work with what we already had. Unfortunately our neighbour preferred the option to repair rather than replace, and Peter was more than willing to accommodate that. They reused the existing fence sheets, re-straightened the poles, removed the old timber rails and replaced them with metal rails, and the end result looks fantastic.

Professional, honest, reliable, and clearly takes pride in his work.

Thank you so much!!
